usedFor: Shopify holds shoppers and their carts, and BulkGate keeps their numbers in its address book through “Add a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add a Contact” in BulkGate
bestTemplate.why: Abandoned shoppers have left an email or phone, so they join the address book for later messages.

watchOut: “Update a Contact” finds a contact by phone number, so abandoned checkouts without one cannot update anyone.
